launchAtLoginOptOut.description: Internal state that records that the user turned launch at login off.

showInMenuBar.description: Whether to show the OpenJoystickDriver item in the menu bar.

showInDock.description: Whether to always show the OpenJoystickDriver icon in the Dock.

controllerConnected.description: Whether a controller that connects or needs attention posts a notification.

controllerDisconnected.description: Whether a controller that disconnects posts a notification.

profileActivated.description: Whether a profile that becomes active posts a notification.

profileDeactivated.description: Whether a profile that is turned off posts a notification.

sounds.description: Whether a notification plays a sound.

checkAutomatically.description: Whether to check for updates when the app starts.

includePrereleases.description: Whether to include pre-release versions when checking for updates.

developerTools.description: Whether to show the developer tools in the Settings window.
